members.title: THE INTRODUCTION AND VERIFICATION OF THERMOCHARGEABLE GALVANIC CELL

relations.subject: Thermochargeable galvanic cell
relations.conditions: Electrodes connected; opposite of the stated high-temperature reaction

evidence: The high-temperature and low-temperature electrodes of a cell containing an [Fe(CN)(6)](3-)/[Fe(CN)(6)](4-) redox couple as the electroactive species were separated by a ion-exchange membrane that did not pass through the redox couple.

When the high-temperature and low-temperature electrodes were connected, the [Fe(CN)(6)](4-) was reduced to [Fe(CN)(6)](3-) at the high-temperature electrode and the opposite reaction took place at the low-temperature electrode.

The high-temperature and low-temperature electrodes of a cell containing the redox couple of [Fe (CN)6]3-/[Fe (CN)6]4- as the electroactive species were separated by the ion-exchange membrane that did not passage of the redox couple.
When the two electrodes were connected, [Fe(CN)6]4- was reduced to [Fe(CN)6]3- at the high-temperature electrode and the opposite reaction took place at the low-temperature electrode.

The power electrodes were located on each side of the membrane.

The high-temperature and low-temperature electrodes of a cell containing the redox couple of [Fe (CN)6]3-/[Fe (CN)6]4- as the electroactive species were separated by the ion-exchange membrane that did not passage of the redox couple.
